reasoning_chain.name: Contract of carriage exists (bill of lading or similar document of title; or port-to-port by sea; or place-to-place with sea leg)
Period of responsibility: tackle-to-tackle (HV) OR port-to-port (HAM) OR door-to-door (ROT)
Carrier's duties: due diligence to make seaworthy + properly and carefully carry (HV); took all reasonable measures (HAM); occurrence during period + not attributable to fault (ROT)
Defences: 17 defences incl. nautical fault (HV); no nautical fault (HAM/ROT)
Limits: 666.67 SDR/2 SDR (HV); 835 SDR/2.5 SDR + 2.5x freight delay (HAM); 875 SDR/3 SDR + 3x freight delay (ROT)
